mostWorthwhile.text: Making and testing the spring-tide prediction was most worthwhile. It connected the Moon and shore through an observable comparison, while distinguishing support from proof.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating Wonder and Question felt rather abstract at first; their purpose became clearer only when applied to the lunar rhythm.

surprise.text: The calendar became a tool for testing a tidal prediction, linking the two seemingly separate goals.

arbitrary.text: Language plus Memory yielding Story made sense, but its role in the sky goal was not initially clear. It was also the only offered gameplay action.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what harder questions the community investigates, particularly if later chapters build on the test-and-share sequence rather than only offering predictable combinations.
